title: Transcript Study View
user: A person who absorbs text better than video or audio and wants a calm, navigable reading version of a talk they are already watching.
current_workaround: Open a platform transcript panel, copy it into a document, use reader mode, or rely on auto-transcripts with awkward line breaks.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension that detects an official transcript/caption track visible to the user and opens a local reader with paragraphs, timestamp jump links, dyslexia-friendly spacing and optional browser TTS.
success_measure: At least 70% of pilot users finish a selected 10-minute talk using the transcript view and use three or more timestamp jumps or saved highlights.
constraints: Use only text/caption tracks the site exposes to the signed-in user; preserve source URL and timestamps; no copyrighted media download or anti-bot bypass; local highlights by default.
